# is-promise

  Test whether an object looks like a promises-a+ promise

 [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/travis/then/is-promise/master.svg)](https://example.invalid/then/is-promise)
 [![Dependency Status](https://example.invalid/gemnasium/then/is-promise.svg)](https://example.invalid/then/is-promise)
 [![NPM version](https://example.invalid/npm/v/is-promise.svg)](https://example.invalid/package/is-promise)

## Installation

    $ npm install is-promise

You can also use it client side via npm.

## API

```javascript
var isPromise = require('is-promise');

isPromise({then:function () {...}});//=>true
isPromise(null);//=>false
isPromise({});//=>false
isPromise({then: true})//=>false
```
